summary:
Documented the completed implementation and verification of all 5 user enhancement requirements for AL RAWAHI GARAGE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM:
1. Detailed Invoice Line Items Linked to Inventory with Quantity, Unit Tracking, and Single Stock Deduction.
2. Overtime Hours Entry, Hourly Rate Snapshot, Auto Total Calculation, Editing, and Monthly Payroll Integration.
3. Optional Permanent vs. Temporary Customer and Vehicle Registration with Non-Intrusive Defaults.
4. Real-time Customer Recognition and Autocomplete Search by Name and Phone.
5. Immediate Direct Printing to Configured Printer with Graceful Error Handling.
All 108 automated tests passing across 25 suites with clean TypeScript compilation and linting.
